A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. The coordinator ruled on 2026-09-25, reviewing valkey EXP34-C batch 2, that src/db.c:729 (selectDb's client parameter, reached through VM_SelectDb) is TP: the golden rule excludes 'no in-tree caller passes NULL' as an FP basis, and an exported module API has callers outside the corpus by design. That is the same standard as a public entry point with no guard (cf. dev-180's sqlite3rbu_progress row in aurora_lint 1531).

The same basis decided six more rows in the 1504 valkey EXP34-C batches, so all seven are corrected here in place. For each one, the exported entry point was read at source and confirmed to forward the pointer with no NULL check:
- src/db.c:729 via VM_SelectDb (module.c:4237), ctx->client NULL for a VALKEYMODULE_CTX_NONE ctx [delta-1504-valkey-exp34c-b2]
- src/module.c:4880, VM_ListInsert's own key parameter, with every earlier branch requiring key != NULL [exp34c-b4]
- src/io_threads.c:100 and src/networking.c:4476 via VM_ACLAddLogEntry (module.c:10625) -> addACLLogEntry, which uses ctx->client when server.current_client is NULL (acl.c:2914; its comment notes the client 'could be missing on module timers') [exp34c-b4, exp34c-b5]
- src/object.c:616 via VM_RetainString (module.c:2925); src/object.c:628 via VM_FreeString (module.c:2885); src/object.c:958 via VM_StringCompare (module.c:3077) [exp34c-b5]

All are confidence medium: the null producer is the open API surface, not a specific in-tree call. Mechanics follow bmdb 1490: in-place edits keeping each key, and the original batches each take a row_count and FP decrement plus a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct keys. No precision/recall claim is made here.
